# S.E.E. Official Library

> Every authoring guide and schema page for the S.E.E. Official Library, combined into one file. It covers how to write workflows, prompts, skills, commands, and bundles, and how to publish them to the catalog.

The Official Library is the package catalog that S.E.E. installs from. A package
is a versioned payload plus an install map, so machinery written in one project
can be used in another.

Two things are authoritative and machine readable:

- `catalog.json` (https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/catalog.json) lists
  every package and where each file installs. Its schema tag is `see.library/v1`.
- The JSON Schema files under
  https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/ define each payload shape.

Each section below mirrors one page on
https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/ and names it on a `Source:` line, in
site order: how to author each package type first, then the payload contracts.
Where a section and a schema file disagree, the schema file wins.

## Contents

Authoring:

- Authoring overview
- Workflows
- Prompts
- Skills
- Commands
- Bundles
- Publish to the catalog

Schema:

- Catalog schema
- Workflow schema
- Prompt schema
- Skill schema
- Command schema
- Rule and template schema
- Bundle schema

---

# Authoring overview

Source: /authoring/

Every package in the Official Library is one of five types. Pick the type, write
its payload, then publish it to the catalog.

## Package types

- [Workflows](/authoring/workflows/): task graphs the engine runs (`definition.json`)
- [Prompts](/authoring/prompts/): named instruction text (`prompt.json`)
- [Skills](/authoring/skills/): activatable capability guides (`SKILL.md`)
- [Commands](/authoring/commands/): worker definitions for an agent CLI (`command.json`)
- [Bundles](/authoring/bundles/): install maps that deliver several packages together

## Publishing

- [Publish to the catalog](/authoring/publish/): payload layout, the `catalog.json` entry, and validation

## Schema reference

- Catalog manifest: [`see.library/v1`](/catalog.json)
- Payload contract: [Catalog schema](/schema/)

---

# Workflows

Source: /authoring/workflows/

A **workflow** package defines tasks the S.E.E. engine runs against a hub or
spoke. Payload file: `definition.json`. Installs to
`.s_e_e/workflows/definitions/{slug}.json`.

Authoring rules live in the bundled **workflow** skill
(`packages/workflow/1.0.0/SKILL.md`) and S.E.E. knowledge docs **doc-13**
(template expansion) and **doc-18** (workflow authoring). This page covers the
library payload shape only.

## Envelope (`definition.json`)

| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Outer id, usually `system-<name>` |
| `name`, `description` | Hub display metadata |
| `content` | Engine workflow object (object or JSON-encoded string on disk) |

## Inner `content`

| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `runtime_inputs` | Run-start values; each object with `key`, `input_type`, `required`, `label`; keys must not contain dots |
| `tasks` | Ordered graph of engine tasks |
| `spoke_root` | Required when command tasks use spoke cwd or git actions omit per-task spoke |

### Task types

Each task has exactly one handler under `function`:

- `cli_command`: shell command and args
- `command`: run a catalog command by `command_id` with optional `prompt`
- `user_input`: collect operator input at run start
- `git_action`, `story_action`, `foreach`, `custom`

### Template references

- `prompt.<id>` (`{{prompt.<id>}}`): inject stored prompt text
- `runtime.<key>` (`{{runtime.<key>}}`): value from `runtime_inputs`
- `userinput.<task_id>.value` (`{{userinput.<task_id>.value}}`): earlier `user_input` task
- `task.<task_id>.output...` (`{{task.<task_id>.output...}}`): captured output from an earlier task

## Reference example

From `packages/implement-story/1.0.0/system-implement-story/definition.json`
(inner `content` pretty-printed):

```json
{
  "id": "system-implement-story",
  "name": "Implement story",
  "description": "Runs a Cursor CLI agent to implement a single story.",
  "content": {
    "id": "implement-story",
    "name": "Implement story",
    "runtime_inputs": [
      {
        "input_type": "string",
        "key": "story_id",
        "label": "Story id",
        "required": true
      }
    ],
    "tasks": [
      {
        "id": "implement_story",
        "name": "Implement story (Cursor CLI)",
        "function": {
          "name": "command",
          "input": {
            "command_id": "cursor-agent",
            "config": { "cursor_model": "composer-2.5" },
            "prompt": "{{prompt.system-implement-story}}"
          }
        },
        "next_tasks": [
          {
            "id": "report_done",
            "name": "Report completion",
            "function": {
              "name": "cli_command",
              "input": {
                "command": "echo",
                "args": [
                  "implement-story finished for {{runtime.story_id}}"
                ]
              }
            },
            "next_tasks": []
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

On disk the engine may store `content` as a JSON string; both forms validate.

## Install path

```json
{
  "to": ".s_e_e/workflows/definitions/system-implement-story.json",
  "from": "packages/implement-story/1.0.0/system-implement-story/definition.json"
}
```

## Schema reference

- Catalog manifest: [`see.library/v1`](/catalog.json)
- Payload contract: [Workflow schema](/schema/workflow/)

---

# Prompts

Source: /authoring/prompts/

A **prompt** package stores reusable system prompt text referenced by workflows
and commands via the `prompt.<id>` template form
(`{{prompt.<id>}}`). Payload file: `prompt.json`. Installs to
`.s_e_e/prompts/{id}.json`.

## Fields

| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Stable prompt id (e.g. `system-implement-story`) |
| `name` | Display name in the hub |
| `content` | Prompt body; may include `runtime.*` placeholders (`{{runtime.*}}`) expanded at run time |

## Reference example

From `packages/system-implement-story/1.0.0/prompt.json`:

```json
{
  "id": "system-implement-story",
  "name": "Implement story",
  "content": "You are implementing story {{runtime.story_id}}. Operate fully autonomously..."
}
```

Use a `system-*` id for bundled defaults. Keep template placeholders aligned
with the workflow `runtime_inputs` that declare each `runtime.<key>` placeholder
(`{{runtime.<key>}}`).

## Install path

```json
{
  "to": ".s_e_e/prompts/system-implement-story.json",
  "from": "packages/system-implement-story/1.0.0/prompt.json"
}
```

## Schema reference

- Catalog manifest: [`see.library/v1`](/catalog.json)
- Payload contract: [Prompt schema](/schema/prompt/)

---

# Skills

Source: /authoring/skills/

A **skill** package teaches an agent a repeatable capability. Payload file:
`SKILL.md`. Installs to `.agents/skills/{slug}/SKILL.md`.

## Shape

YAML frontmatter plus markdown body:

- `name`: short skill id (matches the install folder name)
- `description`: activation text; when the user says these phrases, the agent
  should load this skill

The body documents the procedure, constraints, and links to authoritative docs.

## Reference example

From `packages/work/1.0.0/SKILL.md`:

```markdown
---
name: work
description: >-
  Implements an S.E.E. story with tests until acceptance criteria pass...
  Use when the user says work, "start work", "implement story-N", or works
  through story IDs with acceptance criteria.
---

# Work

Implement an S.E.E. story with tests until all acceptance criteria pass...
```

Write the `description` as a single activation sentence agents can match against
user intent. Keep procedures in the markdown body, not in frontmatter.

## Install path

```json
{
  "to": ".agents/skills/work/SKILL.md",
  "from": "packages/work/1.0.0/SKILL.md"
}
```

## Schema reference

- Catalog manifest: [`see.library/v1`](/catalog.json)
- Payload contract: [Skill schema](/schema/skill/)

---

# Commands

Source: /authoring/commands/

A **command** package defines how the S.E.E. engine runs an external agent CLI
against a spoke workspace. Payload file: `command.json`. Installs to
`.s_e_e/commands/{id}.json`.

## Fields

| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `binary` | Executable name on `PATH` (e.g. `cursor`, `claude`) |
| `base_args` | Arguments always passed before operator overrides |
| `forced_args` | Arguments the engine appends; not overridable |
| `params` | Typed run-time knobs (`string`, `number`, `boolean`, `enum`, `string_array`) mapped to env, timeout, extra args, lock policy, or stream toggle |
| `result` | Success rule (`success_when`), captured fields, optional `applied_paths` and `run_id` strategies |
| `execution` | Working directory (`cwd`: `spoke` or `hub`), lock scope, stream format, `non_interactive` |

Additional fields: `id`, `name`, `icon`, `workspace_arg`, `prompt` delivery,
`env`, and optional `mcp` provisioning.

## Reference example

From `packages/cursor-agent/1.0.0/command.json`:

```json
{
  "id": "cursor-agent",
  "name": "Cursor Agent",
  "binary": "cursor",
  "base_args": ["agent", "-p", "--trust", "--force"],
  "forced_args": ["--output-format", "stream-json", "--stream-partial-output"],
  "params": [
    {
      "key": "cursor_model",
      "type": "string",
      "default": "composer-2.5",
      "map": { "target": "env", "name": "CURSOR_MODEL" }
    },
    {
      "key": "timeout_secs",
      "type": "number",
      "default": 1800,
      "map": { "target": "timeout" }
    }
  ],
  "result": {
    "success_when": "exit_code == 0",
    "capture": ["run_id", "exit_code", "duration_ms", "stdout_tail", "stderr_tail", "truncated"]
  },
  "execution": {
    "cwd": "spoke",
    "lock": { "scope": "spoke", "default_policy": "force" },
    "stream": { "format": "stream-json" },
    "non_interactive": true
  }
}
```

## Install path

Catalog `files[]` entry:

```json
{
  "to": ".s_e_e/commands/cursor-agent.json",
  "from": "packages/cursor-agent/1.0.0/command.json"
}
```

The `to` path must equal `.s_e_e/commands/{id}.json` where `id`
matches `command.json` `id`.

## Schema reference

- Catalog manifest: [`see.library/v1`](/catalog.json)
- Payload contract: [Command schema](/schema/command/)

---

# Bundles

Source: /authoring/bundles/

A **bundle** installs several library packages together. It has no payload file
of its own; the catalog entry `files[]` lists every member install map.

## Metadata (`s_e_e_package.json`)

Each bundle carries a sidecar at `packages/{slug}/s_e_e_package.json`:

```json
{
  "id": "bundle-implement-story",
  "slug": "implement-story",
  "category": "bundle",
  "name": "Implement Story workflows",
  "description": "Packages linked by template references: workflows, prompts, skills, commands.",
  "labels": ["bulk", "story"],
  "dependencies": []
}
```

| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Globally unique package id (`bundle-<slug>`) |
| `slug` | URL-safe folder name under `packages/` |
| `category` | Must be `bundle` |
| `name`, `description` | Catalog presentation |
| `labels` | Discovery tags |
| `dependencies` | Other package ids installed alongside this bundle |

## Members

When harvesting from a local hub, `scripts/bundles.json` lists member package
ids per bundle slug. The harvest script copies each member payload into
`packages/{bundle-slug}/{version}/` and builds the catalog `files[]` array.
Hand-authored bundles list every `to`/`from` pair directly in `catalog.json`.

Example members for `implement-story` (from `scripts/bundles.json`):

- `cmd-cursor-agent`
- `prompt-system-implement-story`
- `skill-work`
- `wf-system-implement-story`
- `wf-system-implement-stories-bulk`

## Install map

Each entry maps a repo path to an install target:

```json
{
  "to": ".s_e_e/prompts/system-implement-story.json",
  "from": "packages/implement-story/1.0.0/system-implement-story/prompt.json"
}
```

The build infers payload kind from the `to` prefix:

- `.s_e_e/workflows/definitions/` → workflow
- `.s_e_e/prompts/` → prompt
- `.s_e_e/commands/` → command
- `.agents/skills/` → skill
- `.cursor/` → rule
- `templates/` → template

## Install path rules

Every `files[]` `to` path must start with one of:

- `.s_e_e/`
- `.agents/`
- `.cursor/`
- `templates/`

Paths use forward slashes and must be unique within the package.

## Schema reference

- Catalog manifest: [`see.library/v1`](/catalog.json)
- Payload contract: [Bundle schema](/schema/bundle/)

---

# Publish to the catalog

Source: /authoring/publish/

After authoring a package payload, add it to this repository and validate before
opening a pull request.

## Payload layout

Place files under:

```
packages/{slug}/{version}/
```

Examples:

- `packages/cursor-agent/1.0.0/command.json`
- `packages/system-implement-story/1.0.0/prompt.json`
- `packages/work/1.0.0/SKILL.md`
- `packages/implement-story/1.0.0/system-implement-story/definition.json`

Add `packages/{slug}/s_e_e_package.json` metadata for every catalog entry.

Bundles copy member payloads under the bundle slug folder, for example
`packages/implement-story/1.0.0/work/SKILL.md`.

## `catalog.json` entry

Append a package object to `catalog.json` `packages[]`:

| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Globally unique id (e.g. `cmd-cursor-agent`, `bundle-implement-story`) |
| `slug` | URL-safe slug matching the `packages/` folder |
| `category` | `workflow`, `prompt`, `skill`, `command`, or `bundle` |
| `version` | Semver string (e.g. `1.0.0`) |
| `author` | Publisher id |
| `verified` | `true` when signed off by a maintainer |
| `license` | SPDX id (e.g. `AGPL-3.0-only`) |
| `requires` | External tools required at install time (empty array when none) |
| `dependencies` | Other package `id`s installed alongside this one |
| `files[]` | Install map with `to` and `from` paths |

Optional presentation fields: `name`, `description`, `labels`.

Example command entry:

```json
{
  "id": "cmd-cursor-agent",
  "slug": "cursor-agent",
  "category": "command",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "author": "garunski",
  "verified": true,
  "license": "AGPL-3.0-only",
  "requires": [],
  "dependencies": [],
  "files": [
    {
      "to": ".s_e_e/commands/cursor-agent.json",
      "from": "packages/cursor-agent/1.0.0/command.json"
    }
  ],
  "name": "Cursor Agent",
  "description": "Cursor CLI agent run against a spoke workspace."
}
```

## Validate and build

```bash
npm run validate
npm run catalog
```

- `npm run validate` runs `node scripts/build-catalog.mjs --check` (read-only;
  fails when payloads or metadata are invalid or out of sync).
- `npm run catalog` validates payloads, refreshes `catalog.json` `updated`, and
  writes any derived fields.

Commit both the payload under `packages/` and the updated `catalog.json`.

## Docs site

```bash
npm run copy
npm run build
npm test
```

`npm run copy` copies root `catalog.json` and `packages/` into `public/` so
Next.js serves them at the published URLs. `npm run build` runs that copy, then
exports the static site.

A new package type also needs a section in `public/llms.txt`, which carries the
same guidance as one plain-text file for agents. `npm test` fails when a page has
no matching `Source:` line, so both change together.

## Schema reference

- Catalog manifest: [`see.library/v1`](/catalog.json)
- Payload contract: [Catalog schema](/schema/)

---

# Catalog schema

Source: /schema/

The catalog is a single JSON manifest (`catalog.json`) plus versioned payload
files under `packages/`. The manifest schema tag is `see.library/v1`. This
section is the authoritative contract for this repository;
`scripts/build-catalog.mjs` enforces it.

Per-type payload schemas:

- [Workflow](/schema/workflow/)
- [Prompt](/schema/prompt/)
- [Skill](/schema/skill/)
- [Command](/schema/command/)
- [Rule and template](/schema/rule-template/)
- [Bundle](/schema/bundle/)

## Manifest

`catalog.json`:

- `schema` - must be `see.library/v1`.
- `name` - catalog display name.
- `updated` - ISO-8601 timestamp (refreshed by `npm run build`).
- `packages[]` - array of package entries.

## Package entry

Each entry in `packages[]`:

- `id` - string, globally unique within the catalog.
- `slug` - string, url/file-safe.
- `category` - one of `workflow`, `prompt`, `skill`, `rule`, `template`, `command`, `bundle`.
- `version` - semver string.
- `author` - string.
- `verified` - bool.
- `license` - SPDX id (e.g. `AGPL-3.0-only`).
- `requires` - string array of external tools that must be present (empty when none).
- `dependencies` - string array of other package `id`s installed alongside this one.
- `files[]` - install map; each entry is `{ to, from }`:
  - `from` - source path in this repo, `packages/{slug}/{version}/{file}`.
  - `to` - destination path written on the install target, relative to the target root.

## Package metadata sidecar

Every package carries a `packages/{slug}/s_e_e_package.json` (or
`s_e_e_package.{id}.json` when a slug has multiple entries); the build
cross-checks it against the catalog entry:

- `id` - package id; matches the catalog entry.
- `slug` - url/file-safe slug.
- `category` - one of the category values above.
- `name` - display name.
- `description` - one-line summary.
- `labels` - string array (the build dedupes and sorts it).
- `dependencies` - string array of other package `id`s.

## Categories

Each category has a fixed payload shape and install destination:

- `workflow` - a workflow definition JSON. Installs to `.s_e_e/workflows/definitions/{slug}.json`.
- `prompt` - a prompt JSON (`id`, `name`, `content`). Installs to `.s_e_e/prompts/{file}.json`.
- `skill` - a `SKILL.md` with `name` + `description` frontmatter. Installs to `.agents/skills/{slug}/SKILL.md`.
- `rule` - a Cursor rule `.mdc` file. Installs to `.cursor/rules/{slug}.mdc`.
- `template` - a scaffold file. Installs under `templates/`.
- `command` - a command definition JSON (`id`, `binary`). Installs to `.s_e_e/commands/{id}.json` (the `to` path must equal this exactly).
- `bundle` - no payload of its own; its `files[]` install several other packages together. The build infers each file's kind from its `to` path.

## Install paths

Every `files[]` `to` path must:

- start with one of `.s_e_e/`, `.agents/`, `.cursor/`, or `templates/`;
- use forward slashes;
- be unique within the package.

For a `bundle`, the `to` prefix determines the payload kind that is validated:

- `.s_e_e/workflows/definitions/…` → workflow
- `.s_e_e/prompts/…` → prompt
- `.s_e_e/commands/…` → command
- `.agents/skills/…/SKILL.md` → skill
- `*.mdc` → rule
- `templates/…` → template

## Validation

`dependencies` must reference package `id`s present in the catalog, and a
package cannot depend on itself. Run `npm run build` to validate payloads and
refresh the manifest, or `npm run validate` (`--check`, no writes) in CI.

## JSON Schema

Download: [catalog.schema.json](https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/catalog.schema.json)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/catalog.schema.json",
  "title": "S.E.E. Library catalog manifest",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["schema", "name", "packages"],
  "properties": {
    "schema": { "const": "see.library/v1" },
    "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "updated": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" },
    "packages": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/package" }
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "package": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "id", "slug", "category", "version", "author",
        "verified", "license", "requires", "dependencies", "files"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
        "slug": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
        "category": {
          "enum": ["workflow", "prompt", "skill", "rule", "template", "command", "bundle"]
        },
        "version": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
        "author": { "type": "string" },
        "verified": { "type": "boolean" },
        "license": { "type": "string" },
        "requires": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
        "dependencies": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 } },
        "name": { "type": "string" },
        "description": { "type": "string" },
        "labels": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 } },
        "files": { "type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/file" } }
      }
    },
    "file": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["to", "from"],
      "properties": {
        "to": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^(\\.s_e_e/|\\.agents/|\\.cursor/|templates/)[^\\\\]*$" },
        "from": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Package metadata sidecar - download:
[package-meta.schema.json](https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/package-meta.schema.json)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/package-meta.schema.json",
  "title": "Package metadata sidecar (s_e_e_package.json)",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["id", "slug", "category", "name"],
  "properties": {
    "id": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "slug": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "category": {
      "enum": ["workflow", "prompt", "skill", "rule", "template", "command", "bundle"]
    },
    "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "description": { "type": "string" },
    "labels": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 } },
    "dependencies": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 } }
  }
}
```

---

# Workflow schema

Source: /schema/workflow/

Category `workflow`. Payload file `definition.json`. Installs to
`.s_e_e/workflows/definitions/{slug}.json`.

An outer envelope wraps the engine `content`:

- `id` - `system-<name>` (defaults) or `user-<name>`. Required.
- `name`, `description`, `version` - strings.
- `content` - the engine workflow object:
  - `id` - required, non-empty.
  - `name` - required.
  - `tasks[]` - required, non-empty.
  - `runtime_inputs[]` - optional; each `{ key, input_type, required, label }`; `key` must not contain dots.
  - `spoke_root`, `hub_root`, `stories_root`, `knowledge_root` - optional root paths.

## Tasks

Each task:

- `id` - unique within the workflow.
- `name` - string.
- `function` - exactly one handler key: `cli_command`, `command`, `user_input`, `git_action`, `story_action`, `foreach`, or `custom`.
- `next_tasks[]` - optional nested tasks (depth-first execution).
- `capture_output` - when true, record handler output for `{{task.TASK_ID.output}}` placeholders.
- `wait_for` - task ids that must complete before this task runs (use a foreach id to wait for all iterations).
- `continue_on_failure` - when true, a failed task completes without failing the workflow; output is still captured when `capture_output` is true.
- `run_when` - object `{ task, path?, op, value? }` gating this task on the captured output of a prior task (`op`: `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `ge`, `le`, `exists`).

A payload containing `tasks` is treated as a workflow (not a prompt).

## Template expansion

```
{{prompt.ID}}              injects a stored prompt; the id must exist in the hub
{{runtime.KEY}}            run-start value; declared in runtime_inputs, no dots
{{userinput.TASK_ID.value}} value from an earlier user_input task
{{task.TASK_ID.output}}    captured output from an earlier task with capture_output: true
                           (cli_command output is { exit_code, stdout, stderr })
```

## JSON Schema

Download: [workflow.schema.json](https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/workflow.schema.json)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/workflow.schema.json",
  "title": "Workflow package payload (definition.json)",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["id", "name", "content"],
  "properties": {
    "id": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "description": { "type": "string" },
    "version": { "type": "string" },
    "content": {
      "oneOf": [
        { "type": "string", "description": "JSON-encoded workflow object" },
        { "$ref": "#/$defs/workflow" }
      ]
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "workflow": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["id", "name", "tasks"],
      "properties": {
        "id": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
        "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
        "spoke_root": { "type": "string" },
        "hub_root": { "type": "string" },
        "stories_root": { "type": "string" },
        "knowledge_root": { "type": "string" },
        "runtime_inputs": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/runtime_input" }
        },
        "tasks": {
          "type": "array",
          "minItems": 1,
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/task" }
        }
      }
    },
    "runtime_input": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["key", "input_type"],
      "properties": {
        "key": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[^.]+$",
          "description": "Referenced as {{runtime.KEY}}; no dots."
        },
        "input_type": { "type": "string" },
        "required": { "type": "boolean" },
        "label": { "type": "string" }
      }
    },
    "task": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["id", "name", "function"],
      "properties": {
        "id": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
        "name": { "type": "string" },
        "function": { "$ref": "#/$defs/function" },
        "next_tasks": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/task" }
        },
        "capture_output": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "default": false,
          "description": "Record handler output for `{{task.<id>.output...}}` templates"
        },
        "wait_for": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
          "description": "Task ids that must complete before this task runs"
        },
        "continue_on_failure": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "default": false,
          "description": "Treat a failed task as complete so descendants and captured output stay reachable"
        },
        "run_when": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/condition",
          "description": "Gate execution on a prior task's captured output"
        }
      }
    },
    "condition": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["task", "op"],
      "properties": {
        "task": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "Producer task id (capture_output: true)"
        },
        "path": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
          "default": [],
          "description": "Path into producer output (e.g. exit_code, stdout)"
        },
        "op": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["eq", "ne", "gt", "lt", "ge", "le", "exists"]
        },
        "value": {
          "description": "Comparison value; omit when op is exists"
        }
      }
    },
    "function": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["name"],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "enum": [
            "cli_command",
            "command",
            "user_input",
            "git_action",
            "story_action",
            "foreach",
            "custom"
          ]
        },
        "input": { "type": "object" }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

See the [workflow authoring guide](/authoring/workflows/) and the
[catalog schema](/schema/).

# Prompt schema

Source: /schema/prompt/

Category `prompt`. Payload file `prompt.json`. Installs to
`.s_e_e/prompts/{file}.json`.

- `id` - prompt id used by `{{prompt.ID}}`. Required, non-empty; may carry a namespace prefix.
- `name` - display name. Required, non-empty.
- `content` - prompt body; a single string (use `\n` for line breaks).
- `created_at` - ISO-8601 timestamp. Optional.

A payload that contains `tasks` is treated as a workflow, not a prompt.

## JSON Schema

Download: [prompt.schema.json](https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/prompt.schema.json)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/prompt.schema.json",
  "title": "Prompt package payload (prompt.json)",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["id", "name"],
  "not": { "required": ["tasks"] },
  "properties": {
    "id": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "content": { "type": "string" },
    "created_at": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" }
  }
}
```

See the [prompt authoring guide](/authoring/prompts/) and the
[catalog schema](/schema/).

---

# Skill schema

Source: /schema/skill/

Category `skill`. Payload file `SKILL.md`. Installs to
`.agents/skills/{slug}/SKILL.md`.

`SKILL.md` is YAML frontmatter plus a markdown body. Frontmatter:

- `name` - non-empty skill name.
- `description` - non-empty activation description an agent matches against.

The markdown after the frontmatter is the skill instructions.

## JSON Schema

The payload is a markdown file; this schema describes its YAML frontmatter
block. Download: [skill-frontmatter.schema.json](https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/skill-frontmatter.schema.json)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/skill-frontmatter.schema.json",
  "title": "Skill SKILL.md YAML frontmatter",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["name", "description"],
  "properties": {
    "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "description": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 }
  }
}
```

See the [skill authoring guide](/authoring/skills/) and the
[catalog schema](/schema/).

---

# Command schema

Source: /schema/command/

Category `command`. Payload file `command.json`. Installs to
`.s_e_e/commands/{id}.json` (the `to` path must equal this exactly).

- `id` - unique command id; also the install filename. Required, non-empty.
- `name`, `icon` - display metadata.
- `binary` - executable to run. Required, non-empty.
- `base_args` - args always passed.
- `forced_args` - args the engine appends; operators cannot override them.
- `workspace_arg` - `{ flag, value }` for passing the working directory.
- `prompt` - prompt delivery (e.g. `{ "delivery": "stdin" }`).
- `params[]` - typed parameters; each has `key`, `type`, optional `default`, and `map.target` (`env`, `timeout`, `args_append`, `lock_policy`, `stream_toggle`).
- `env` - static environment variables.
- `result` - `success_when` plus `capture[]`.
- `execution` - `cwd` (`spoke`/`hub`), `lock`, `stream`, `non_interactive`.
- `mcp` - optional MCP provisioning. `{ enabled, mechanism? }`. When `enabled` is true and `mechanism` is omitted, delivery defaults to `env`. Mechanisms:
  - `{ "type": "env" }` - inject `SEE_MCP_*` and `MCP_CONFIG`.
  - `{ "type": "config_file", "path": ".cursor/mcp.json", "format": "mcp_servers" }` - write workspace-relative config (restored after the run).
  - `{ "type": "arg", "flag": "--mcp-config", "format": "mcp_servers" }` - pass a temp config file via argv.

A payload with `content` but no `binary` is treated as a prompt.

## JSON Schema

Download: [command.schema.json](https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/command.schema.json)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/command.schema.json",
  "title": "Command package payload (command.json)",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["id", "binary"],
  "properties": {
    "id": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "name": { "type": "string" },
    "icon": { "type": "string" },
    "binary": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "base_args": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "forced_args": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "workspace_arg": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "flag": { "type": "string" },
        "value": { "type": "string" }
      }
    },
    "prompt": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": { "delivery": { "type": "string" } }
    },
    "params": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/param" }
    },
    "env": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "result": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "success_when": { "type": "string" },
        "capture": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }
      }
    },
    "execution": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "cwd": { "enum": ["spoke", "hub"] },
        "lock": { "type": "object" },
        "stream": { "type": "object" },
        "non_interactive": { "type": "boolean" }
      }
    },
    "mcp": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "enabled": { "type": "boolean" },
        "mechanism": { "$ref": "#/$defs/mcpMechanism" }
      }
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "mcpMechanism": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["type"],
      "properties": {
        "type": { "enum": ["env", "config_file", "arg"] },
        "path": { "type": "string" },
        "flag": { "type": "string" },
        "format": { "type": "string", "enum": ["mcp_servers"] }
      }
    },
    "param": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["key"],
      "properties": {
        "key": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
        "type": { "type": "string" },
        "default": {},
        "map": {
          "type": "object",
          "required": ["target"],
          "properties": {
            "target": {
              "enum": ["env", "timeout", "args_append", "lock_policy", "stream_toggle"]
            },
            "name": { "type": "string" }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

See the [command authoring guide](/authoring/commands/) and the
[catalog schema](/schema/).

---

# Rule and template schema

Source: /schema/rule-template/

Two lightweight, file-only categories.

## Rule

Category `rule`. Payload is a Cursor rule `.mdc` file (markdown with rule
frontmatter). Installs to `.cursor/rules/{slug}.mdc`.

## Template

Category `template`. Payload is an arbitrary scaffold file. Installs under
`templates/`.

See the [catalog schema](/schema/) for the manifest and install-path rules.

---

# Bundle schema

Source: /schema/bundle/

Category `bundle`. No payload of its own.

A bundle's catalog `files[]` array installs the payloads of several other
packages together; the build infers each file's kind from its `to` prefix (see
[Install paths](/schema/#install-paths)).

Bundle metadata lives in its `s_e_e_package.json`:

- `id` - bundle id (e.g. `bundle-author-story`).
- `slug` - url/file-safe slug.
- `category` - `bundle`.
- `name` - display name.
- `description` - one-line summary.
- `labels` - string array.
- `dependencies` - string array of the package `id`s it pulls in.

## JSON Schema

Schema for a bundle's `s_e_e_package.json`. Download:
[bundle-package.schema.json](https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/bundle-package.schema.json)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://garunski.github.io/s_e_e_library/schema/bundle-package.schema.json",
  "title": "Bundle metadata (s_e_e_package.json)",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["id", "slug", "category", "name"],
  "properties": {
    "id": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "slug": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "category": { "const": "bundle" },
    "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "description": { "type": "string" },
    "labels": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 } },
    "dependencies": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 } }
  }
}
```

The bundle's `files[]` entries follow the `file` definition in the
[catalog schema](/schema/#json-schema).

See the [bundle authoring guide](/authoring/bundles/) and the
[catalog schema](/schema/).
